eps.d: Beavis and Butt-Head must participate in Mr. Van Driessen's 60's experiment, so they set out to go door-to-door. While they are out the boys meet someone unexpected.
Beavis and Butt-Head want money, so they donate their blood to a charity blood bank
Beavis and Butt-Head go to the aquarium with helium filled balloons.
Mrs. Dickie shows how unimpressed she is with Beavis and Butt-Head's science project, she forces them to work on a new project with Daria Morgendorffer.
Beavis and Butt-head run up charges on Mr. Anderson's credit card at a pet shop.
Beavis and Butt-head's incompetence forces Mr. Anderson to wait in the Burger World drive-thru.
Beavis and Butt-head must work together to care for a sugar sack "baby" because none of the girls in class want to partner up with them.
Beavis and Butt-head cause trouble a drive-in movie theater.
Beavis and Butt-head attend a freak show and try to score with the Rubber Band Lady.
Beavis and Butt-head mistreat the customers at Burger World.
Beavis and Butt-head see a doctor after getting sick, hoping to score some powerful cold medicine.
Beavis and Butt-Head are hired by Mr. Anderson to paint his house
Beavis and Butt-Head take a trip to Mexico and on their way back to the States they are questioned by border agents
Beavis and Butt-Head take a trip to Mexico and on their way back to the States they are questioned by border agents.
Beavis and Butt-head ransack the drive-in movie theater and take all the concessions.

Principal McVicker attempts a radical solution to Beavis and Butt-Head's stupidity and continuous laughing in class: they cannot laugh at anything they hear for a week, or risk being expelled and sent to a different high school.
Beavis and Butt-Head struggle hugely to avoid laughing during Buzzcut's sexual education class.
During a boring day at Burger World, Butt-Head falls asleep and dreams about being in a rock band with Beavis.

Beavis and Butt-Head are ordered to prune the top of Mr. Anderson's tree, but take a disastrous shortcut on their job by sawing through the trunk. The tree falls on his house and power lines, which fells utility poles onto parked cars.
Beavis and Butt-Head go to Stewart's house to watch a pay-per-view special, but get bored with it and cause chaos inside the house.
Mr. Van Driessen makes Beavis and Butt-Head write haikus in class.
Beavis and Butt-Head torment a post-heart surgery patient, Billy Bob, by stealing his scooter and crashing it.
Beavis and Butt-Head try out for a mud wrestling act at the local strip club, but are turned down because they are underage.
Beavis and Butt-Head buy frozen yogurt but are unimpressed by the taste of it. When refused a refund, they take a messy revenge on the mall.
Beavis and Butt-Head go to a skeet shooting range, where they cause a Boeing 747 to crash by firing too high into the air.
Beavis and Butt-Head volunteer to wash Mr. Anderson's dog in hopes that he would leave them money in his will.
Beavis and Butt-Head hang out at Maxi-Mart in an attempt to pick up chicks and meet a biker chick who uses them to shoplift.
Beavis and Butt-Head ponder enlisting in the U.S. Army as "Major Woody" and "Private Parts", but run afoul of Col. Dick Leakey. The boys end up causing havoc with some bullets and an active grenade.
The duo go to a comedy club where Butt-Head's stand-up comedy fails. When Beavis takes his turn on stage, he sets fire to the building after burning newspapers with which to juggle.
The two are hired to wash a Chevrolet Corvair in order to pay for new TV remote batteries, but decide to take it for a ride. They stop on a junction, where another car crashes into it.
Beavis and Butt-Head create a dangerous and illegal hobby with a fishing pole and the junk found deep in the cracks of their sofa.

Under threat of possible death from Earl, a gun-holding classmate, the duo assume ridiculous disguises and pretend to be exchange students. When someone outside the class fires at them, the two exonerate Earl, and in gratitude, Earl spares their lives.
The duo conceive a plot to kidnap Stewart for ransom so they can attend a heavy metal concert.
Beavis and Butt-Head, upon discovering the concept of a nudist colony, attempt to join one. They cannot afford the membership fee, so they climb over the wall.
Beavis and Butt-Head bike to a trailer park to check out a tornado.
Beavis and Butt-Head are hired by Mr. Van Driessen to clean his house, but the duo end up destroying his entire 8-track tape collection.
The duo get a dollar and win $500 by buying a lottery ticket. They then buy a riding mower, which they use to cut a circle-A in the lawn in front of Highland High School.
McVicker restarts a Scared Straight program and the duo find themselves having fun in prison.
Beavis and Butt-Head enter a bratwurst-eating contest. They are unaware of and unable to pay the entrance fee, so they have to work with frogs to pay it.

Coach Buzzcut orders Beavis and Butt-Head to buy jockstraps for gym class because neither of them have any. The store's smallest supporters are too big for both of them, so they are given eyepatches instead, which Daria writes about in the school paper.
The duo sell sperm at the offices of Dr. Rod Johnson, and buy porn magazines with the money.
Beavis and Butt-Head are so muscularly atrophied that they are forced to stay after gym class for a personal workout with Coach Buzzcut.
President Bill Clinton is about to visit Highland High, so McVicker does his best to keep Beavis and Butt-Head preoccupied by sending the boys off-campus.
The duo accidentally run for student office and receive one vote.

The duo take to bowling as their latest activity. While there, they steal Mr. Anderson's bowling ball, put firecrackers in it and drop it from the roof of the building onto the street. Anderson is arrested for the 'bombing'.
The duo try to score chicks while hitchhiking and are picked up by a religious cult who takes them to meet "God", their leader.
Various crime documentary television shows report on Beavis and Butt-Head's theft of money from a cash machine.
Butt-Head must defend himself and Beavis in court after both are charged with vandalizing Anderson's property.
Beavis and Butt-Head become infatuated with a bully named Todd and attempt to join his gang.
Beavis and Butt-Head go to Stewart's house, where they pick up an antique plate belonging to Stewart's mother. They go outside and use it as a frisbee.
Van Driessen takes the duo and Stewart on a canoe trip. At their camp, Beavis and Butt-Head use poison ivy as toilet paper and a bear attacks Van Driessen.
Mistaken for geniuses, Beavis and Butt-Head are placed in advanced classes at Highland High.
Beavis and Butt-Head befriend, and influence, a foreign exchange student from Japan.
Beavis and Butt-Head must deal with a health inspector after making a gigantic mess at Burger World.
Extended episode. An escaped mental patient hides from the authorities at Butt-Head's house.
